name: sartain_pro_motion
source: WHOP PRO FIX 03_MOTION — less is pro. Overrides MOTIONS.md defaults for talking-head WHOP clips.

data_gate.note: Only assign data motion if its trigger regex matches the sentence at that timestamp. Otherwise, caption alone does the job. Prevents 12-graphic spam.

mode_policy.card_uses: blurpad behind plate, not transparent over face (QC face_zone must pass)

variety_rule.original: never same motion twice in a row
variety_rule.pro_override: allow data motion to repeat if numbers demand; only enforce variety for FEEL motions (flare/heart/burst)
variety_rule.code: if motion == last_motion and last_motion_job == 'FEEL': skip else: allow

easing.inside_graphic: drift 100→103% + shine 1.2s (AUDIT 1.15) — motion lives INSIDE graphic, not as transition FX

notes: Apply: import in motion/validate.py and motion/decide.py. See README.md for patches. Expected: 28s clip drops from 12→3 graphics, render time 90s→25s, retention up (viewer watches face, not slides).
